notes.title: ASTRO: The Beginning is officially released on Steam!
notes.content:
ASTRO: The Beginning - a side-scrolling shooter about a tight-knit team of space adventurers facing a challenge of a cosmic scale is now out on Steam! Take part in epic space fights with myriads of enemies and huge murderous bosses, but don't be fooled, ASTRO: The Beginning is not so easy to beat!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35038362/4f772683ed79824c830b3d2042968c6b4520e160.gif[/img]

notes.title: Palych — tough bear
notes.content:
Palych (aka Mikhail Stickwood) is a tough bear who in his past robbed other spaceships and killed for a living. But everything changed after he met Astro. Astro's good nature amazed Stickwood so much that the space pirate decided to start an honest life under his leadership.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35038362/47292ef8a44d81fa73e36f08f603e190691011ab.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Amer Din
notes.content:
Time to meet another member of the team! Today we will introduce you to the cheeky cat Amer Din.

He looks cute and fluffy, but only at first glance.
Believe me, it's better not to argue with him, because intelligent conversations are definitely not his thing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35038362/9d3329f80436b60e74410c2f8847205074f9b5f6.png[/img]

notes.title: Meet Astro
notes.content:
Well, let's start to get acquainted with the main characters! So, meet Astro. Astro Degrey Ryder is a gentle dog of noble blood with sense of morality, commander of the most elite detachment of the Federation fleet;) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35038362/233d0973eaa56361abfab44e92c4ea9711641a7f.png[/img]

notes.title: ASTRO
notes.content:
ASTRO is a retro like side scrolling space shooter. 

Choose one of four playable characters – the noble dog Astro, the cheeky cat Amer Dean, the tough bear Palych or the smart panda Ling – and run into danger. 

You will engage in crazy boss battles and encounter myriads of enemies, which you can destroy using 15 types of weapons and characters’ special abilities. All weapons are upgradable and can be interchanged even during the fight. 

You can enjoy ASTRO using both the keyboard and the controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35038362/b6e7e0065e13cbe7459de415503b4175d7b168b6.png[/img]
